decision_statement: An evaluation implementation issue was found and corrected.
executive_summary: The previously reported 1.0000 Aspect and Opinion F1 was caused by an evaluation implementation issue in scripts/evaluate.py where empty predicted span lists fell back to gold spans (if not p_asp: p_asp = g_asp), inadvertently evaluating gold spans against themselves. Furthermore, the regression stage was previously supplied with gold span coordinates, which constitutes Gold-Span Oracle evaluation rather than End-to-End inference. This has been corrected by implementing two explicitly separated evaluation modes: Mode A (End-to-End Predicted Spans) and Mode B (Gold-Span Oracle).

audit_1_trace_aspect_opinion_f1.question_5_does_evaluation_decode_biaffi: Initially decoded internally in BiaffineSpanExtractor but omitted from top-level model output dict, causing fallback in evaluate.py.
audit_1_trace_aspect_opinion_f1.question_6_is_predicted_span_output_comp: Previously no (gold compared against gold due to fallback). In revised pipeline, yes (predicted candidate spans compared against gold spans using exact token matching).

audit_2_no_gold_span_leakage.mechanism: In Mode A, aspect_spans and opinion_spans are set to None. Downstream representations are pooled strictly from the top decoded predicted spans.

audit_3_no_gold_va_leakage.mechanism: Gold valence and arousal targets are never accepted or processed by model forward passes or H-NSG/RGAT modules. Mutating targets has zero impact on predictions.

shared_conditions: Exact same batch size and collation
Exact same JointVALoss formulation during training
Identical span decoding policy during inference

audit_5_mode_separation.mode_a_description: Model predicts aspect and opinion spans without gold coordinate inputs; top predicted spans condition downstream regression.
audit_5_mode_separation.mode_b_description: Gold span boundaries supplied directly to regression heads to benchmark dimensional sentiment regression in isolation.

audit_9_high_switch_density_observation.empirical_observation: Under High Switch Density (rho >= 0.30), the Switch-Unaware Baseline exhibited negative correlation (r_V = -0.1973, r_A = -0.1843), whereas NSSG-DimNet exhibited r_V = -0.0020 (Delta = +0.1953) and r_A = +0.1596 (Delta = +0.3439). The mechanism of cross-lingual attention mitigation remains an unproven theoretical hypothesis.
